verses.text: Haxo Jesús ix och ijan yalan jun ab'ix. Ix yalan icha tik: --Ay jun winh ix awan juntzanh te' uwa t'a sat sluum. Ix smakan winh yet' k'een tz'alk'een. Ix sb'oan jun yet'tal b'aj stek'chajel yal te' uwa chi' winh. Ix sb'oanpaxk'e jun b'aj tz'aj heb' stanhwan te' uwa chi' winh, chaanh ix ajk'ei. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anb'at sluum winh chi' majanil yet' te' uwa chi' t'a juntzanh heb' winh munlajwum. Ix b'atkan winh t'a junxo lugar najat.
Haxo ix jawi stiempoal smolchajel sat te', ix schekanb'at jun schekab' winh t'a heb' winh majnum lu'um chi', yik b'at schaan smajananub'al lum b'aj tz'el te' uwa chi' yalani.
Haxo ix k'ochi, ix syamankot heb' winh smak'ani. Ix spechan paxta heb' winh. Malaj jab'ok tas ix yik'a'.
Haxo winh aj lu'um chi' ix chekanb'at junxo schekab' t'a heb' winh. Haxo ix k'ochi, ix ste b'ajej heb' winh, ix lajwi sjolom smak'an heb' winh.

Yuj chi', haxo winh aj lu'um chi' ix chekanb'at junxo schekab'. Haxo ix k'och junxo chi', ix smilancham heb' winh. Tzijtumto heb' schekab' winh ix schekb'ati. Ay heb' tonhej ix mak'ji, ay heb' ix miljicham yuj heb' winh.
Palta ay jun yuninal winh te xajan yuj. Slajwub'xo chi', ix schekanb'at yuninal winh chi'. Tekan ol xiw heb' winh t'a jun wuninal tik, xchi winh.

Palta haxo yik wan sk'ochi, ix smol halan heb' winh: Ina sjawi winh uninab'il tik. K'inalok ol cham winh smam winh, haxo winh ol ikankan lu'um. Ko milekcham winh, yik a t'ayonh ol kan lu'um, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' haxo ix k'ochi, ix syamankot heb' winh. Ix smak'ancham heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' winh syumkanel sniwanil t'a stitak awb'en chi'.

Yuj chi' tzin k'anb'ej t'ayex, a winh aj lu'um chi', ¿tas ol yutok heb' winh majnum lu'um chi' winh tze na'a? Ha winh aj lu'um chi' ol b'at satanel heb' winh. Slajwi chi' ol yak'ankanb'at sluum winh chi' majanil t'a juntzanhxo.
¿Tom manta b'aj tzeyil t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, b'aj syal icha tik? Ha jun k'een k'een malaj yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' b'oum pat, haton k'een ix ochkan sjolomok schikin te' pat chi'.
Icha tik ix aj yuj Dios Kajal. Yuj chi' ayik skilani, ste sat ko k'ool yuj, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios chi', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Haxo heb' winh yajal ix sayani tas ol yutok heb' winh syamchaj Jesús chi', yujto ix nachajel yuj heb' winh to yuj heb' winh ix alji jun ab'ix chi'. Palta ix xiw heb' winh t'a heb' anima. Yuj chi' ix yaktejkan Jesús chi' heb' winh. Ix pax heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix chekjib'at jaywanh heb' fariseo yet' heb' spartido winhaj Herodes t'a Jesús. Snib'ej heb' syak' prowal, talaj ay junok slolonel ay palta syutej yalani. Yujto snib'ej heb' syak'och t'a yib'anh.

Ix b'at yalan heb' t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, kojtak to te yel tzala'. Kojtakpaxi to jun lajannhej yilji heb' anima t'ayach. Haxo jun b'eyb'al snib'ej Dios, a tzak' k'ayb'aj t'a yel. ¿Tas tza na'a? Ha juntzanh tumin sk'anjiel t'ayonh yuj winh yajal t'a Roma, ¿wach' am skak'a', mato maay? ¿Ay am sleyal skak'a', mato maay? xchi heb' t'a Jesús.
Palta yojtakxo Jesús to tonhej stz'ak sk'anb'ej heb' icha chi'. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj tzin eyak' prowal? B'at ik'ekkot junok tumin chi' wila'', xchi t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at yik'kot jun tumin chi' heb'. Ix sk'anb'an Jesús chi' t'a heb': --¿Mach ayoch yechel sat t'a jun tumin tik? ¿Mach tz'ib'ab'iloch sb'i tik t'ay? xchi t'a heb'. --Haton yechel winh yajal t'a Roma yet' sb'i winh, xchi heb'.
--Ha tas yiktaxon winh yajal chi', ak'ek t'a winh. Palta a tas yiktaxon Dios, a tzeyak' t'ay, xchi t'a heb'. Haxo ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', ix te sat sk'ool heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ay juntzanh heb' saduceo ix k'och t'a Jesús. Ha heb' chi' syal heb' to manh ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, yuj chi' ix yalan heb' t'ay:

--Ach ko k'ayb'umal, a winhaj Moisés tz'ib'annakkan icha tik: K'inalok ay junok mach schami, skan ix yetb'eyum, palta malaj junok yuninal. Tato icha chi', haxo junok yuk'tak yowalil tz'ik'ankan ix, yik wach' tato tz'aj yuninal junxo winh chi', ichato yuninal winh ix cham chi' tz'ajkani. Icha chi' yaj yalankan winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha junel, ay ukwaanh winak, yuk'taknhej sb'a heb' winh. Ha winh b'ab'el winak ik'an jun ix ix. Palta cham winh. Malaj junok yuninal winh kani.
Haxo winh schab'il yuk'tak winh ik'ankan ix. Palta champax junxo winh chi', malaj pax junok yuninal winh kani. Icha chi' aj pax winh yoxil.
Hanhejtona', icha chi' ek' heb' winh yukwanhil t'a ix. Malaj junok yuninal heb' winh ajnakkani. Slajwi scham heb' winh yukwanhil, ichato chi' scham ix.
Ayik ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, ¿mach junok heb' winh ol ik'an ix? Yujto yik'nak ix heb' winh yukwanhil, xchi heb' saduceo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb': --Tonhej tzex te somchaji, yujto manh eyojtakok tas syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani. Manh eyojtakok jantak spoder Dios.
Ayik ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, manhxalaj ik'lajb'ail, yujto lajan ol aj heb' yet' heb' ángel ay t'a satcha'anh.

Palta toxonton chekelxo yaji to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak. ¿Tom manta b'aj tzeyil tas stz'ib'ejnakkan winhaj Moisés t'a Slolonel Dios chi', a slolonnak Dios t'a skal te' k'iix? Xchi Dios icha tik: Ha in ton tik sDiosal in winhaj Abraham, sDiosal in winhaj Isaac, sDiosal in pax winhaj Jacob, xchi.

Yuj chi' kojtak, wach'chom chamnak heb' t'a sat heb' anima, palta haxo t'a sat Dios manh satnakokel-laj heb', pitzan heb' t'a yichanh, yujto yalnakkani to sDiosal heb' yaji. Ha ex tik te somchajnak ex, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ay jun winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ix k'och ta'. Ix yab'an winh to wan stelan sb'a heb' winh saduceo chi' yet' Jesús. Ix yab'anpax winh to wach' ix yutej Jesús spakan t'a heb' winh, yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winh t'ay: --¿B'aja junok cheknab'il te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh smasanil? xchi winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús: --Ha jun cheknab'il te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh smasanil, xchi icha tik: Ab'ek ex wetisraelal, a Kajal ko Diosal, junnhej toni.
Tze xajanej Kajal ko Diosal t'a smasanil he k'ool, t'a smasanil he pixan, t'a smasanil he pensar yet' t'a smasanil eyip, xchi. Haton jun cheknab'il tik te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh smasanil.

Haxo junxo ol wal tik, ken manh lajanok yelk'och yet'ok. Xchi icha tik: Ichaokab' tzeyutej eya'ilan he b'a, ichaokab' chi' tzeyutej he xajanan heb' ay t'a spatik schikin he pat, xchi. Malaj junokxo cheknab'il ek'al yelk'och t'a yichanh chab' tik, xchi Jesús.
Ix yalanxi winh k'ayb'um chi' t'ay: --Wach' ton Mamin, yel ton tzala'. Junnhej ton Dios, malaj junokxo.

Yowalil sko xajanej Dios t'a smasanil ko k'ool, t'a smasanil ko pensar yet' t'a smasanil kip. Hanhejtona' yowalil icha skutej ko ya'ilan ko b'a, ichaokab' chi' skutej ko xajanan heb' ay t'a spatik schikin ko pat. Haton chab' cheknab'il tik, te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh masanil juntzanh silab' smilji yet' juntzanh silab' snhusji tz'ak'ji t'a Dios, xchi winh t'ay.

Haxo ix yab'an Jesús to wach' ix yutej winh yalani, ix yalanxi t'a winh: --Jab'xonhej wal och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi', malaj junokxo mach ix stek'b'ej sb'a sk'anb'an junokxo tas t'a Jesús chi'.
Ha junel, ix sk'ayb'ej heb' anima Jesús t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios, ix yalani: --¿Tas yuj syal heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés to a Cristo yinhtilal winhaj David?

Palta yuj Yespíritu Dios yalnak winhaj David chi' to a Cristo Yajal yaj t'a winh, xchi icha tik: Ha Dios Kajal alannak t'a Wajalil icha tik: Emanh k'ojan t'a in wach' k'ab' tik, masanto ol wak'kanoch heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach t'a yalanh ok, xchi Dios t'a Wajalil, xchi winhaj David chi'.

Icha chi' yutejnak winh yalankani to a Cristo Yajal yaj t'a winh. Yuj chi', ¿tom yinhtilalnhej winhaj David chi' yaji? xchi Jesús t'a heb'. Manh jantakok heb' anima ix ab'an jun tik. Ix te tzalaj heb' yab'ani.

Ayik wan sk'ayb'an heb' anima Jesús, ix yalani: --Tzeyil wal he b'a, yujto a heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, te ay smay sb'eyb'al heb'. Snib'ej heb' sb'eyek' yet' spichul te jukan. Haxo yik tzek' heb' t'a calle, ste k'echaanh heb' ayik slaj yak'anem sb'a heb' anima t'a heb'.
Ha t'a yoltak spatil culto, anhej t'a xila heb' niwak winak snib'ej heb' tz'em k'ojan. Yet' pax t'a yik tz'och juntzanh niwak wael, anhej t'a yet'tal heb' winh niwak winak tz'aj heb'.

Syik'anek' heb' tastak ay t'a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Slajwi chi', te najat syutej yok slesal heb', yik sna heb' anima to malaj smul heb'. Yuj chi', yelxo wal niwan yaelal ol och t'a yib'anh heb', xchi Jesús.

Ha junel, ix och Jesús t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios. Ix em k'ojan t'a stz'ey jun chalab' ofrenda. Ix yilani chajtil tz'aj yak'anem stumin heb' anima. Tzijtum heb' b'eyum ix ek' ta'. Niwak stumin heb' ix ek' yak'kanemi.
Palta ix k'och jun ix chamnak yetb'eyum te meb'a'. Ix yak'anem chab' yunetak tumin ix, te jab'nhej yelk'ochi.

Ix yawtankot heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi', ix yalan t'a heb': --Wal yel swal t'ayex, a jun ix chamnak yetb'eyum tik, te meb'a' ix. Palta a jun yofrenda ix, ix yak' tik, ek'to yelk'och t'a yichanh yofrenda smasanil juntzanhxo heb' ix ek' yak'em yik t'a yol jun chalab' ofrenda tik.
Yujto a tas syak' sobre t'a heb', ha' ix laj yak'em heb'. Palta a jun ix tik, te meb'a' ix. Ha masanil yik sgasto ix, ix yak'emi. Manhxalaj tas ix kan t'a ix, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
